summary: Three CodeSnippet blocks highlighting Svelte, TypeScript and CSS sources.
use: Documentation or settings pages that display code samples with syntax highlighting.
spec: `import { CodeSnippet } from '@codeatlasdev/ui/code'` is the entry point
`<CodeSnippet code={svelte} language="svelte" />` shows an `AppList` markup sample
`<CodeSnippet code={css} language="css" />` shows rules using design tokens
